name: Cuisine du Cambodge - 02 - Publication approuvée Facebook et création Instagram

parameters.query: WITH chosen AS (SELECT id FROM cuisine_social.posts WHERE status='approved' AND human_decision='approved' AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND source_snapshot->'socialRights'->'approved'='true'::jsonb AND source_snapshot->>'_social_approval_seal'=encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(facebook_caption,instagram_caption,image_url,source_snapshot->'socialRights')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AND image_url ~ '^https://www[.]cuisine-du-cambodge[.]com/social-assets/[a-z0-9-]+[.]jpg$' AND scheduled_date <= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AND fb_state='pending' AND ig_state='pending' ORDER BY scheduled_date,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE cuisine_social.posts p SET status='publishing',fb_state='submitting',ig_state='creating',publishing_started_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() FROM chosen WHERE p.id=chosen.id RETURNING p.*

WITH recorded AS (UPDATE cuisine_social.posts SET fb_state='published',facebook_post_id=$1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$2 AND fb_state='submitting' AND $1 ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*(_[1-9][0-9]*)?$' RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM recorded
